items.title: The Limits of a Five-Star Rating
items.topic: how online ratings influence choices about restaurants, services, and products
items.topicJa: オンラインの星評価が店やサービス、商品の選択に与える影響
items.benefit: ratings summarize many experiences quickly and can warn customers about repeated problems
items.benefitJa: 多くの体験を素早く要約し繰り返される問題を利用者に知らせられること
items.challenge: averages hide differences in expectations, timing, sample size, and who chooses to leave a review
items.challengeJa: 平均値は期待の違い、時期、件数、誰が投稿するかという差を隠すこと
items.lesson: a compact score is useful only when readers also consider the evidence behind it
items.lessonJa: 短い数値評価はその背景にある証拠も考えてこそ役立つ

items.title: Why Cities Keep Some Old Buildings
items.topic: the debate over preserving older buildings while cities need new housing and facilities
items.topicJa: 住宅や施設が必要な都市で古い建物を保存する議論
items.benefit: historic buildings can preserve identity, craftsmanship, memories, and tourism value
items.benefitJa: 歴史的建物は地域の個性、技術、記憶、観光価値を残せること
items.challenge: preservation can be expensive and may limit safer, denser, or more accessible new construction
items.challengeJa: 保存には費用がかかり安全性や高密度化、バリアフリー化を妨げる場合があること
items.lesson: good planning compares cultural value with present and future public needs instead of treating either as absolute
items.lessonJa: 文化的価値と現在・将来の公共の必要を比較することが重要

items.title: When Shortcuts Become the Normal Route
items.topic: how temporary shortcuts in organizations can gradually become permanent habits
items.topicJa: 組織で一時的な近道が次第に恒常的な習慣になる仕組み
items.benefit: shortcuts can help teams respond quickly during unusual pressure or emergencies
items.benefitJa: 非常時や強い負担の中で素早く対応できること
items.challenge: if temporary exceptions are never reviewed, safety checks and useful records may slowly disappear
items.challengeJa: 例外を見直さないと安全確認や必要な記録が徐々に失われること
items.lesson: flexibility is valuable when organizations also decide when normal safeguards must return
items.lessonJa: 柔軟性には通常の安全策へ戻す時期を決めることも必要

items.title: The Unequal Value of Free Time
items.topic: why an extra hour of free time does not have the same effect for everyone
items.topicJa: 自由時間が一時間増えても全員に同じ効果がない理由
items.benefit: more free time can support rest, learning, relationships, exercise, and creative activity
items.benefitJa: 休息、学習、人間関係、運動、創作を支えられること
items.challenge: people differ in money, caregiving duties, transport, health, and control over when that hour occurs
items.challengeJa: お金、介護、交通、健康、時間を選べる自由に違いがあること
items.lesson: time should be understood together with the resources and constraints that shape how it can be used
items.lessonJa: 時間はそれを使うための資源や制約と合わせて考える必要がある
